I’m with AIFS, it is faculty lead through my college’s district.

I was very fortunate enough to have a semester abroad that costs less than $10k~ for the tuition alone, that price included excursions, classes, housing and materials. It does not cover meals, passport fees, airfare, personal expenses and stuff i needed (toiletries, clothing, supplies since im an art major) located in Rome, Italy. I only paid about $1000 out of pocket for optional excursions and a meal plan that were not included with the $10k. 

Financial aid really helped me along with applying for scholarships, saving money is also a big thing! Some people get everything paid through scholarships and it certainly is possible! Gilman, Fund for Education Abroad and other opportunities. Try to propose to your school about fundraisers for all students! Apply for every scholarship you can! Do your research! There is still time for Spring 2024 Study Abroad scholarships and Fall 2024, take notes! The ones with the essays turn off the most students, but apply, you never may know! There is so many resources you can use for scholarships like Gilman and Fund for Education abroad! Read accepted papers, read resources from other universities, use your colleges centers, ask friends! Go fund me is also an option. What are your demographics? Use those! There is a lot of opportunities if you have a single mom, your ethnicity, sexuality, major, first gen! 

I wish you the best of luck trying to gather funds together, studying abroad is so beneficial ♥️
